quotes.text: Bug 1901912 records that the broad bug 1851535 cleanup accidentally removed MessengerProfileMigrator XPCOM registration and broke the --migration command-line flag. A later fix restored registration; current mail/components/components.conf still registers the constructor. This is an umbrella-bug regression, not evidence that D211683 alone caused it. When deleting apparently dead components, check command-line and migration consumers that may instantiate a class indirectly by contract.
